text:
incident-bot: Paging: elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate (ingress-gateway). 5m error rate 4.2%. Severity: page. Oncall: tasha. Runbook: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/ingress-5xx Please ACK and collect correlation IDs.

tasha: acked, looking now :eyes:

sam: I'm here, pulling kvlogs and proxy metrics. any known deploys?

tasha: no deploys in last 30m per eng-releases. Sam can you grab a handful of correlation ids and example logs?

sam: grabbing sample. early snippet:
```
{"ts":"2026-03-17T15:12:04Z","correlation_id":"corr-7f2b-1","path":"/v1/generate","status":502,"upstream_host":"model-host-2","upstream_error":"recv_timeout","upstream_retries":3,"latency_ms":12034}
{"ts":"2026-03-17T15:12:05Z","correlation_id":"corr-7f2b-2","path":"/v1/generate","status":502,"upstream_host":"model-host-2","upstream_error":"connection_reset","upstream_retries":2,"latency_ms":9800}
```

maria: seeing the same in egress metrics — model-host-2 CPU spike + 5xxs and a retry storm. Also ingress-proxy queue depth jumped to 850, p99 queue wait up 300ms. Hypothesis: upstream overload causing retries -> gateway 502 amplification.

tasha: that matches traces. customers affected: acme-corp (high volume), beta-apps. current failure rate ~3% org-wide, higher for a few tenants. tagging CS.

ben: mitigation plan: 1) cap upstream retries to 1, 2) increase conn timeout to avoid fast repeated retries, 3) route a fraction of traffic to model-lite as fallback. applying now.

ben: patching upstream config:
```bash
kubectl -n ingress patch configmap/gw-proxy --patch '{"data":{"upstream_retries":"1","upstream_timeout_ms":"45000"}}'
# rolling restart ingress-proxy-*. will be gradual
```

sam: started collecting kvlog bundle for corr ids: corr-7f2b-1, corr-7f2b-2, corr-8a3c-4, corr-8a3c-7. uploading to shared dropbox: https://drop.redwood.ai/incident-3185554321/logbundle

tasha: deploying route-fallback canary: 10% of /v1/generate -> model-lite. will monitor error rate and latency.

maria: added dashboards: https://monitor.redwood.ai/d/ingress/5xx-playback, watch p95 latency, upstream error count.

sam: early signal: after caps & canary, 5xx rate dropped to 1.1% in last 5m. queue depth down to 240. continuing to observe. :thumbsup:

engops-bot: Incident annotated in timeline: https://incidents.redwood.ai/3185554321. add notes for RCA.

tasha: collecting timeline: initial spike at 15:10Z, retries amplified 15:11-15:18Z, mitigation started 15:22Z (retry cap), 15:25Z (route canary), 15:30Z observed drop. storing KV logs and traces in dropbox.

ben: next steps for RCA: reproduce load against model-host-2 to validate overload threshold, audit autoscaler config for model nodes, consider connection backoff in gateway.

sam: adding brief to postmortem with correlation ids and snippets. will attach screenshots and graphs.

tasha: CS notified and outbound note drafted for impacted customers. keeping thread open until we have full timeline and root cause.

maria: flagging for follow-up: possible need for capacity increase or model replica placement changes for model-host-2 pool.

incident-bot: Page status: mitigated -> monitoring. Please update postmortem checklist and add owners for follow-up actions.
